title: Alleged mockery of PWDs in PBB Collab 3.0 to be discussed by MTRCB, NCDA
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Disability sensitivity in relation to a video from Pinoy Big Brother (PBB): Collab 3.0 episode will be discussed by the Movie Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB)…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Disability sensitivity in relation to a video from Pinoy Big Brother (PBB): Collab 3.0 episode will be discussed by the Movie Television Review and Classification Board (MTRCB) when it meets with officials of the National Council on Disability Affairs (NCDA). This is according to the MTRCB on Monday, Nov. 23. This developed as the MTRCB received the NCDA’s letter regarding a video depicting some housemates “imitating speech characteristics associated with persons with disabilities (PWD).” The meeting with NCDA Executive Director Glenda Relova and Jayme Mariño, chief of NCDA’s Information, Education and Communication Division, will be held on Tuesday, […]...
